'''Dams Denna''' was an animal trainer who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and worked for the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]]. During the celebration that followed the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Denna helped guide [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpasets]] and [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]] ridden by members of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] delegation during a parade in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. Denna was a collector of [[Linn'con]] memorabilia.

==Biography==
By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC 40">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Dams Denna was a respected [[animal trainer]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where he served as a beast handler for the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]].<ref name="CSWE I 183" /> During the victory parade that followed the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Denna took the reins of beasts such as [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpasets]] and [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]] that had been brought by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] delegation as they joined their [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] counterparts to celebrate their unified victory over the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|forces]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Denna personally handled the kaadu ridden by the Gungan [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}.</ref> When the Gungan became tangled in his kaadu's reins upon dismounting, Denna helped him free himself.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|108|VIC 1-4|Victory on Naboo}}.</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Dams Denna was a skillful animal trainer and herd-master who was renowned for his talent at handling [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] beasts. He collected [[Linn'con]] memorabilia. During the celebration that followed the Battle of Naboo, the light-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] had shoulder-length [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and was of small height. He wore a green jerkin, breeches, and [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="DD CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Trust us, these costumes will look cool on film[.]|[[Jon Bradley Snyder]], on the green costumes worn by himself, Dan Madsen, and other extras in ''Episode&#32;I''|<ref name="I Was an Episode I Easter Egg!">{{InsiderCite|48|I Was an Episode I Easter Egg!}}</ref>}}
[[File:KennyR2andDan.jpg|thumb|left|Dan Madsen (right) with Kenny Baker and R2-D2 on the set of ''Episode I'']]
The animal handler who appears in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] was played by [[Dan Madsen]], one of several ''[[Star Wars]]'' fans and [[Lucasfilm]]-affiliated employees who were selected as extras for the [[1999]] film's final crowd scenes, overseen by the assistant second-unit director, [[Bernard Bellew]]. At the time, Madsen was the publisher of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine and the president of the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Official ''Star Wars'' Fan Club]].<ref name="I Was an Episode I Easter Egg!" /> Nearly a [[1998|year before]] the film's release, a behind-the-scenes photograph of Madsen and fellow actor [[Kenny Baker]] published in [[Star Wars Insider 39|''Star Wars Insider'' 39]] showed Madsen in his Theed costume.<ref name="WAMW ">{{InsiderCite|39|When Artoo Met Wicket}}</ref> Of the fans and employees chosen to appear in ''The Phantom Menace'', only Madsen's character appears clearly in the final motion picture.<ref name="I Was an Episode I Easter Egg!" /> Nevertheless, Madsen's name does not appear in the movie's credits.<ref name="TPM" />

The Naboo animal handler went unnamed until the release of ''[[Theed Palace Limited]]'', a [[2001]] expansion to the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] published by [[Decipher]] The character's name, "Dams Denna," is an [[Tuckerization|anagram]] of "Dan Madsen."<ref name="DD CCG" />
